title: Create FastAPI app skeleton, health endpoint, and Alembic migrations setup
description:
Create the FastAPI application skeleton with a health endpoint, and initialize Alembic with pgvector support.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/__init__.py
- chatbot/config.py
- pyproject.toml (for FastAPI and alembic deps)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

Files to create:

1. chatbot/api/__init__.py — empty package init (or minimal docstring)

2. chatbot/api/app.py — FastAPI application factory:
   - create_app() function that returns a FastAPI instance
   - Sets title="Chatbot API", version from chatbot.__version__
   - Registers the health router from chatbot.api.health
   - Adds a root GET / redirect or simple message
   - Module-level app = create_app() for uvicorn import

3. chatbot/api/health.py — health endpoint:
   - APIRouter with prefix="" or "/health"
   - GET /health returns {"status": "ok"} (no DB/Redis checks yet)

4. alembic.ini — Alembic configuration:
   - script_location = migrations
   - sqlalchemy.url = (empty or placeholder — will read from env at runtime)
   - Standard alembic logging config

5. migrations/env.py — Alembic env with asyncpg/psycopg async support:
   - Import Settings from chatbot.config
   - Configure target_metadata = None (no models yet, will be added in phase c)
   - Use connectable from settings.database_url
   - Run migrations in 'offline' and 'online' modes

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
